def card(work):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    months = np.arange(24)
    y = 100000 + 8000 * months + rng.normal(0, 5000, 24)
    r = stats.linregress(months, y)
    a, b = (rng.normal(50, 5, 12), rng.normal(43, 9, 12))
    t = stats.ttest_ind(a, b, equal_var=False)
    se = math.sqrt(a.var(ddof=1) / 12 + b.var(ddof=1) / 12)
    t_manual = (a.mean() - b.mean()) / se
    va, vb = (a.var(ddof=1) / 12, b.var(ddof=1) / 12)
    welch_df = (va + vb) ** 2 / (va ** 2 / 11 + vb ** 2 / 11)
    _w(work, 'stats.json', {'slope_per_month': r.slope, 'r2': r.rvalue ** 2, 'welch_t': t.statistic, 'p': t.pvalue, 'note': 'n=12 per group is small'})

def card(work):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    n = 200
    X = rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 2))
    y = (X[:, 0] + rng.normal(0, 1.0, n) > 0).astype(int)
    mu, sd = (X.mean(0), X.std(0))

    def knn1(Xtr, ytr, Xte):
        m, s = (Xtr.mean(0), Xtr.std(0))
        a, b = ((Xtr - m) / s, (Xte - m) / s)
        d = ((b[:, None, :] - a[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(-1)
        return ytr[d.argmin(1)]
    train_acc = float((knn1(X, y, X) == y).mean())
    folds = np.array_split(rng.permutation(n), 5)
    cv = []
    for k in range(5):
        te = folds[k]
        tr = np.concatenate([folds[j] for j in range(5) if j != k])
        cv.append(float((knn1(X[tr], y[tr], X[te]) == y[te]).mean()))
    _w(work, 'cv.json', {'engine': 'numpy 1-NN pipeline (scikit-learn not used)', 'train': train_acc, 'cv': cv, 'cv_mean': float(np.mean(cv))})
    return [_c('training score of 1-NN is 1.0 (says nothing)', train_acc == 1.0, train_acc), _c('5-fold CV is clearly lower on noisy labels', np.mean(cv) < 0.9, np.mean(cv)), _c('CV beats chance (0.5)', np.mean(cv) > 0.55, cv), _c('five folds evaluated', len(cv) == 5, len(cv))]
